"Tracking the World State with Recurrent Entity Networks" arxiv

sources_considered.why: Read successfully to verify the paper's version, publication history and story-understanding evaluations.
Primary description of persistent entity memory and its use in story reasoning.
Primary description and evaluation of an existing agent learning and using an environment model for decisions.

evidence_items.locator: Section 1, Introduction, description of entity memory
evidence_items.explanation: EntNet maintains entity-related memory, updates it as a story unfolds and uses it for question answering. Its evaluations concern simplified stories, but directly instantiate the functional definition of a persistent cognitive model.

evidence_items.locator: Introduction, paragraph introducing Dreamer; sections Learning the World Model and Performance on Control Tasks
evidence_items.explanation: Dreamer represents an environment with compact states and uses predicted trajectories to learn actions. It is a direct counterexample to the broad denial of internal world representations informing choices, though not evidence of literary understanding.

unresolved_gaps: These demonstrations do not establish human-level literary understanding, emotional experience or general-purpose cognitive models.
